test_suite.notes: Lint and typecheck clean. vitest: 196 files passed, 2 skipped; 700 tests passed, 14 skipped; coverage thresholds held. Playwright (Chromium + WebKit): 164 passed, 12 skipped, 0 failed. CI run 45101354935 on 959c890 (HEAD): every job success (Tooling tests skipped by design).

end_to_end.command: production build served by vite preview at http://localhost:4173 (the spec's Run command), driven in Chromium and WebKit
end_to_end.expected: Randomise line-up sits beside the Opponents heading. At 9 players each press redraws all 8 rows across the four style labels and leaves seats and names alone. Start game seats the rows' styles at the table. Soft, then randomise, then Tough brings back the Tough rows. Hands play without errors.
end_to_end.actual: The button sits to the right of the heading, on the same row, inside the Opponents panel. At 9 players each press made exactly eight 1-word crypto requests and no 4-word ones. A forced all-Maniac draw changed every row and left seats and names unchanged. Seven real presses produced only valid labels and all four of them. Enter and Space both trigger the button. The Mixed radio stayed checked and no 'Custom' text appeared. Start game after a randomise plus a later edit seated exactly those styles (game type and stake toggles kept the edits). Two hands played with no console or page errors and no further 1-word draws. Hand 1 drew exactly one replay code. The button box is at least 44x44 and axe found no serious or critical violations.

integrity.notes: doit.py test-integrity TASK-2.9 exited 0 with no warnings or errors. The diff of the four locked files only inserts 'Randomise line-up' after '← Home' in a button list: tests/ui/home.acceptance.test.tsx (TASK-2.1), tests/ui/game-config-game-type.acceptance.test.tsx (TASK-2.4), tests/ui/game-config-stake.acceptance.test.tsx and e2e/stake-choice.spec.ts (TASK-2.3). No other expected value changed. The product diff has no special-casing of test inputs, no hard-coded expected values and no mocks of the unit under test. The stub in the e2e spec only replaces 1-word crypto draws, which is the injected source the spec calls for. git diff --stat -- src e2e tests was empty at the end of judging.

items.evidence: The builder's e2e passes in Chromium and WebKit. Holdout at 9 players: there were 0 one-word crypto calls before the press and exactly 8 after each press (72 after 9 presses, including keyboard Enter and Space). There were no 4-word calls. Rows changed under a forced draw and seats, names and 'You' were unchanged. Real presses showed only the four labels and all four appeared. Box >= 44x44, axe clean, no page errors. Mutant check: the builder's SPEC-01 test still passes when the button does nothing (see J-1-01); the other two specs catch that mutant.

The builder's test passes and tabulates per seat with the 180-320 bound; a %3 mutant fails it. Holdout: 12,000 seeded draws at 2, 3, 6, 9 and 10 players under 3 seeds each. Per-seat chi-square (df 3) stayed below the p=0.999 critical value. The joint chi-square for the first two bots (df 15) stayed below its critical value, so draws are independent. Keys were exactly the bot seats and never the user seat.

The builder's test passes; a mutant that reverses seat order fails it. Holdout for each preset (Mixed, Tough, Soft): the draw 3,2,1,0,3 seats {6 Rock, 1 Maniac, 2 Calling station, 3 TAG, 4 Rock} and lineUp is Custom (or the preset name when the styles match). A draw equal to the preset's own styles (words offset by multiples of 4) keeps the preset name. configWithSeatStyles equals folding configWithSeatStyle one seat at a time. seatSession keeps userSeat and the drawn styles.

The builder's e2e passes in both browsers and fails under the no-op-button mutant. Holdout: a stubbed draw 3,0,2,1,3 followed by a manual edit to Eli reaches the table with exactly those styles by seat. The header reads 'Cash · 6 players · $4/$8 · Hand #1'.

The builder's e2e passes in both browsers. Holdout: an earlier Ben edit was replaced by an all-Calling-station draw. A later Eli edit stacked on the draw. A players change from 6 to 3 and back restored Mixed. Soft, then randomise, then Tough restored the Tough rows. Game type and stake toggles kept the edits.

The builder's render test passes for the default and 2-player configs and checks the header markup, button order and type=button. Holdout in the browser: the button is to the right of the h2, vertically centred on the same row and inside the section.

The builder's unit tests pass. Mutants (%3, reversed order, no freeze, a relaxed upper bound) each fail at least one test. Holdout: the source is called exactly n-1 times in clockwise order for n=2..10. 0 maps to TAG, 0xfffffffe to Maniac and 0xffffffff to Rock. RangeError for -1, -0.5, +/-Infinity, 2^32, 2^53 and a non-number. With crypto and Math.random trapped, randomBotStyles touched neither and did not mutate its input.

npm test passed (700 passed) and npm run e2e passed (164 passed, Chromium + WebKit). The four locked edits are list insertions only. The holdout confirmed that Start game still draws exactly one 4-word replay code and that the randomiser never makes a 4-word request.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: the 9-player browser test fails if pressing Randomise line-up does not change any row. Actual: with the button's handler turned into a no-op, that test still passes, because the default 9-player Mixed rows already show valid labels. The SPEC-04 and SPEC-05 tests do catch this, so the suite as a whole is not blind to it.
findings.fix: The 9-player test should prove the press redrew the rows, for example by forcing a known draw or counting one 1-word draw per bot seat.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected (storyboard): the Opponents header wraps on narrow screens without horizontal scroll. Actual: at 320-375 px viewports the Game Config page already scrolls horizontally (scrollWidth 388) because of the TASK-2.8 opponent rows/selects. Hiding the new button does not change that width, so the button adds no overflow. This is pre-existing, not a regression from this story.
findings.fix: Optional follow-up: let the Opponents panel content (rows/selects) shrink to the viewport on narrow screens.

summary: All 11 SPEC items pass. Unit (700) and e2e (164, Chromium + WebKit) suites are green locally and CI is green on HEAD. test-integrity is clean, and the four locked edits only add 'Randomise line-up' to button lists. Independent seeded tabulation (12,000 draws x 5 sizes x 3 seeds) confirms uniform, independent per-seat draws. In the browser each press makes exactly one 1-word crypto request per bot and never a 4-word one, the rows actually change, and drawn styles reach the table. Edits replace, stack and clear as specified, and hands play without errors. There are no blocking findings, one MEDIUM test-strength note (J-1-01) and one LOW pre-existing narrow-screen overflow (J-1-02).
